cards.title: Counting tools: quick review
cards.body: Stars and bars: $n$ identical things into $k$ boxes, $\binom{n + k - 1}{k - 1}$; at least one each, $\binom{n - 1}{k - 1}$. Inclusion–exclusion: $|A \cup B| = |A| + |B| - |A \cap B|$; with three sets, add back the triple. "Neither" $=$ total $-$ union.

cards.title: Probability: quick review
cards.body: $P = \frac{\text{good}}{\text{all}}$ with equally likely outcomes; $P(\text{not } E) = 1 - P(E)$. Geometric: good length or area over total. Expected value: weight each value by its probability; expected values add.

cards.title: How the check works
cards.body: First a short warm-up. Then the check: $8$ AMC-style problems with choices, easiest first, no hints. You need all $8$ right (100%) to pass. If you miss one, you'll see the solutions and which skills to review, and the next try gives you new problems.
